page_title: Supplier Workflow - Dudhiya Milk Collection App
workflow_guide_subtitle: Learn how Dudhiya helps farmers connect with dairies, view their milk collections, and track earnings - all in one simple app!
step1_description: As a farmer, you can connect with multiple collection centers (buyers/dairies). Once connected, you can view all your milk delivery details and track payments from each dairy in one place!
step1_feature1_desc: Link with all collection centers where you supply milk
step1_feature2_desc: See contact info, location, and rates of each buyer
step1_feature3_desc: Track pending and approved connection requests
step1_feature4_desc: Send connection requests to new dairies with one tap
step2_description: Suppliers (Farmers) can VIEW their milk collection history but CANNOT add or edit collections. Only the Buyer (Collection Center) can record your milk deliveries. You get complete transparency!
step2_feature1_desc: See all your milk deliveries recorded by the buyer
step2_feature2_desc: Check quantity, FAT, SNF, rate & total for each delivery
step2_feature3_desc: Filter by dairy, date range, or shift (Morning/Evening)
step2_feature4_desc: Track which collections are paid or pending
step3_description: Suppliers can VIEW their earnings and download reports shared by buyers. You cannot generate your own reports - the collection center (Buyer) creates and shares them with you. View your complete payment history!
step3_feature1_desc: Access PDF/Excel reports shared by collection centers
step3_feature2_desc: Track total earnings across all connected dairies
step3_feature3_desc: See all payments received with dates and amounts
step3_feature4_desc: Download reports shared by buyers and share via WhatsApp
buyer_role_title: What Does the Buyer (Collection Center) Do?
buyer_role_subtitle: It's important to understand that Suppliers (Farmers) and Buyers (Collection Centers) have different roles in Dudhiya. Here's what the Buyer does:
buyer_resp1_desc: The Buyer (Collection Center) adds farmers to their system and manages supplier profiles with complete details.
buyer_resp2_desc: Only Buyers can add/edit milk collections. When you deliver milk, they record quantity, FAT, SNF, and calculate payments.
buyer_resp3_desc: Buyers create PDF/Excel reports and bills, then share them with you via WhatsApp or email. You can only VIEW these reports.
supplier_remember_note: As a Supplier, you can only VIEW data. The Buyer manages all the data entry and report generation.
more_features_subtitle: Additional tools to help farmers manage their dairy business
wallet_balance_desc: Track your earnings and payment history from all connected dairies in one place.
payment_notifications_desc: Get instant notifications when payments are received from collection centers.
multi_language_desc: Use the app in English, Hindi, Punjabi, or Kannada as per your preference.
download_reports_desc: Download reports shared by buyers to keep offline records on your device.
easy_sharing_desc: Share your collection reports with family or accountants via WhatsApp/Email.
support_24_7_desc: Get help anytime through in-app chat or call support for any issues.
first_month_free_no_card: Lifetime Free - No Credit Card Required!
ready_track_title: Ready to Track Your Milk Deliveries?
ready_track_subtitle: Join thousands of farmers across India using Dudhiya to stay connected with their dairies and track earnings. Start your digital journey today!
